audit_status.review_note: Compact complete draft reviewed as Eliphaz's third speech: accusation list against Job, distance-of-God claim, flood/wicked tradition, call to return to Shaddai, and restoration promise. Marked as Eliphaz's speech, not final theology.

verses.restored: Eliphaz the Temanite answered and said:

familiar.text: Then Eliphaz the Temanite answered and said,

verses.restored: Can a strong man be useful to the Divine? Surely one with insight is useful to himself.

familiar.text: Can a man be profitable unto God, as he that is wise may be profitable unto himself?

verses.restored: Is it delight to Shaddai if you are righteous, or gain if you make your ways whole?

familiar.text: Is it any pleasure to the Almighty, that thou art righteous? or is it gain to him, that thou makest thy ways perfect?

verses.restored: Is it because of your fear that he reproves you and enters judgment with you?

familiar.text: Will he reprove thee for fear of thee? will he enter with thee into judgment?

verses.restored: Is not your evil great, and your iniquities without end?

familiar.text: Is not thy wickedness great? and thine iniquities infinite?

verses.restored: For you took pledges from your brothers for nothing and stripped the naked of clothing.

familiar.text: For thou hast taken a pledge from thy brother for nought, and stripped the naked of their clothing.

verses.restored: You gave no water to the weary to drink, and from the hungry you withheld bread.

familiar.text: Thou hast not given water to the weary to drink, and thou hast withholden bread from the hungry.

verses.restored: But the strong-armed man had the land, and the favored one dwelled in it.

familiar.text: But as for the mighty man, he had the earth; and the honourable man dwelt in it.

verses.restored: Widows you sent away empty, and the arms of orphans were crushed.

familiar.text: Thou hast sent widows away empty, and the arms of the fatherless have been broken.

verses.restored: Therefore snares are around you, and sudden dread terrifies you,

familiar.text: Therefore snares are round about thee, and sudden fear troubleth thee;

verses.restored: or darkness, so that you cannot see, and a flood of waters covers you.

familiar.text: Or darkness, that thou canst not see; and abundance of waters cover thee.

verses.restored: Is not the Divine high as the heavens? See the head of the stars, how high they are!

familiar.text: Is not God in the height of heaven? and behold the height of the stars, how high they are!

verses.restored: Yet you say, What does the Divine know? Can he judge through deep cloud?

familiar.text: And thou sayest, How doth God know? can he judge through the dark cloud?

verses.restored: Clouds are his hiding place, so he does not see, and he walks on the vault of the heavens.

familiar.text: Thick clouds are a covering to him, that he seeth not; and he walketh in the circuit of heaven.

verses.restored: Will you keep the ancient path that wicked people have trodden,

familiar.text: Hast thou marked the old way which wicked men have trodden?

verses.restored: who were snatched away before their time, whose foundation was poured out like a river?

familiar.text: Which were cut down out of time, whose foundation was overflown with a flood:

verses.restored: They said to the Divine, Depart from us, and, What can Shaddai do to us?

familiar.text: Which said unto God, Depart from us: and what can the Almighty do for them?

verses.restored: Yet he filled their houses with good things; but the counsel of the wicked is far from me.

familiar.text: Yet he filled their houses with good things: but the counsel of the wicked is far from me.

verses.restored: The righteous see and rejoice; the innocent mocks them,

familiar.text: The righteous see it, and are glad: and the innocent laugh them to scorn.

verses.restored: saying, Surely our adversary is cut off, and fire consumes what remains of them.

familiar.text: Whereas our substance is not cut down, but the remnant of them the fire consumeth.

verses.restored: Become familiar with him, please, and be at peace; by this good will come to you.

familiar.text: Acquaint now thyself with him, and be at peace: thereby good shall come unto thee.

verses.restored: Please receive instruction from his mouth, and place his words in your heart.

familiar.text: Receive, I pray thee, the law from his mouth, and lay up his words in thine heart.

verses.restored: If you return to Shaddai, you will be built up; if you put injustice far from your tents,

familiar.text: If thou return to the Almighty, thou shalt be built up, thou shalt put away iniquity far from thy tabernacles.

verses.restored: and place gold ore in the dust, and the gold of Ophir among the stones of the wadis,

familiar.text: Then shalt thou lay up gold as dust, and the gold of Ophir as the stones of the brooks.

verses.restored: then Shaddai will be your gold and choice silver for you.

familiar.text: Yea, the Almighty shall be thy defence, and thou shalt have plenty of silver.

verses.restored: Then you will delight yourself in Shaddai and lift your face to the Divine.

familiar.text: For then shalt thou have thy delight in the Almighty, and shalt lift up thy face unto God.

verses.restored: You will pray to him, and he will hear you, and you will pay your vows.

familiar.text: Thou shalt make thy prayer unto him, and he shall hear thee, and thou shalt pay thy vows.

verses.restored: You will decide a thing, and it will be established for you, and light will shine on your ways.

familiar.text: Thou shalt also decree a thing, and it shall be established unto thee: and the light shall shine upon thy ways.

verses.restored: When they are brought low, you will say, Lift up; and he will save the lowly of eyes.

familiar.text: When men are cast down, then thou shalt say, There is lifting up; and he shall save the humble person.

verses.restored: He will deliver even one who is not innocent; he will be delivered through the cleanness of your hands.

familiar.text: He shall deliver the island of the innocent: and it is delivered by the pureness of thine hands.
